annotations.title: Prepare a group flight quote request

description: Checks a group flight enquiry for 10 or more seated travellers and returns the exact brief that would go to a human specialist, with a confirmation_token valid for 15 minutes. Nothing is sent.

children.description: Travellers aged 2–11, each in their own seat.

children_ages.description: Age of each child, one entry per child.

date_flexibility_days.description: How many days either side of the given dates the group can move. 0 means fixed dates.

destination.description: Arrival airport as an IATA code, e.g. ["BCN"].

email.description: Where the quote is sent. Required.

infants.description: Under 2, travelling on an adult lap. They do not occupy a seat and do not count towards the group of 10.

market.description: Which market handles the enquiry: en (easygroupflights.com), pl (grupoweloty.pl) or at (gruppenfluege.at). Defaults to en.

note.description: Anything that shapes the fare: what the group is (school trip, wedding, sports team, conference), baggage or equipment needs, budget, who pays, whether names are known yet.

origin.description: Departure airport as an IATA code, e.g. ["LHR"]. Several codes are allowed when the group converges from more than one city.

phone.description: Contact number in international form, e.g. +441244568183. Required: a group specialist may phone to confirm details.

return_date.description: Return date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for a one-way group booking.

return_destination.description: Return leg arrival airports, if travellers go home to a different city.

return_origin.description: Return leg departure airports, if the group flies home from somewhere other than the destination.

youths_ages.description: Age of each youth, one entry per youth.

name: egf_prepare_group_quote

domain.description: The market whose desk handles the enquiry.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time after which the token is refused.

reply_to.description: Where the quote will be emailed.

return_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Absent for one way.

title: Prepare a group flight quote request
